import 'package:state_kit/state_kit.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_config.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_scope.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_copy.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/data/models/plus_entitlement.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/paywall/paywall_cubit.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/paywall/plus_cubit.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/toast/toast_cubit.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/toast/toast_layer.dart';
import 'package:kit_ui/kit_ui.dart';

/// Sample Plus: benefits, plans, the trial timeline, the terms and links.
class PaywallScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PaywallScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<PaywallScreen> createState() => _PaywallScreenState();
}

class _PaywallScreenState extends State<PaywallScreen> {
  final ScrollController _scroll = ScrollController();
  bool _atEnd = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _scroll.addListener(_track);
  }

  void _track() {
    final atEnd =
        _scroll.hasClients &&
        _scroll.position.pixels >= _scroll.position.maxScrollExtent - 4;
    if (atEnd != _atEnd) setState(() => _atEnd = atEnd);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scroll.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = KitColors.of(context);
    final scope = AppScope.of(context);
    final cubit = context.read<PaywallCubit>();
    final plus = context.value<PlusCubit, PlusEntitlement?>();
    final ios = defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS;
    return ToastLayer(
      child: SafeArea(
        bottom: false,
        child: BlocSignalListener<PaywallCubit, PaywallState>(
          listener: (context, state) {
            switch (state.status) {
              case PaywallStatus.closed:
                Navigator.of(context).maybePop();
              case PaywallStatus.failed:
                context.read<ToastCubit>().show(
                  'Something went wrong. Please try again.',
                );
                cubit.acknowledge();
              case PaywallStatus.nothingToRestore:
                context.read<ToastCubit>().show('No purchases to restore.');
                cubit.acknowledge();
              case _:
                break;
            }
          },
          child: BlocSignalBuilder<PaywallCubit, PaywallState>(
            builder: (context, state) {
              final products = cubit.products;
              final selected = products.firstWhere(
                (p) => p.period == state.selected,
              );
              final now = scope.clock.now();
              final reminderDay = now.add(
                const Duration(days: AppConfig.trialReminderDay),
              );
              final chargeDay = now.add(
                const Duration(days: AppConfig.trialDays),
              );
              final per = selected.period == PlusPeriod.yearly
                  ? 'year'
                  : 'month';
              final busy =
                  state.status == PaywallStatus.purchasing ||
                  state.status == PaywallStatus.celebrating ||
                  state.status == PaywallStatus.restoring;
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: KitSpace.l),
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    KitTopBar(
                      onClose: () => Navigator.of(context).maybePop(),
                      trailingLabel: 'Restore Purchases',
                      onTrailing: busy ? null : cubit.restore,
                    ),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Stack(
                        children: [
                          ListView(
                            controller: _scroll,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 44),
                            children: [
                              Center(
                                child: SizedBox(
                                  width: 120,
                                  height: 84,
                                  child: Stack(
                                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                                    children: [
                                      Positioned(
                                        bottom: 0,
                                        child: Container(
                                          width: 120,
                                          height: 80,
                                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                            color: c.lilac,
                                            borderRadius:
                                                const BorderRadius.only(
                                                  topLeft: Radius.circular(60),
                                                  topRight: Radius.circular(60),
                                                  bottomLeft: Radius.circular(
                                                    20,
                                                  ),
                                                  bottomRight: Radius.circular(
                                                    20,
                                                  ),
                                                ),
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                      KitBadgeArt(
                                        celebrateTick: state.celebrateTick,
                                        open: plus != null,
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 10),
                              Text(
                                'SAMPLE PLUS',
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                style: KitType.overline.copyWith(
                                  color: c.lilacInk,
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 2),
                              Semantics(
                                header: true,
                                child: KitBalancedText(
                                  'Room for every item',
                                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                  style: KitType.title.copyWith(color: c.ink),
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 12),
                              const KitFeatureRow(
                                icon: KitIcons.star,
                                title: 'No item limit',
                                detail: 'Free covers 3',
                                tone: KitFeatureTone.sage,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 2),
                              const KitFeatureRow(
                                icon: KitIcons.chart,
                                title: 'Insights',
                                detail:
                                    'How each item is doing over time',
                                tone: KitFeatureTone.dew,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 2),
                              const KitFeatureRow(
                                icon: KitIcons.book,
                                title: 'Guides',
                                detail: 'What to change as things shift',
                                tone: KitFeatureTone.peach,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 2),
                              const KitFeatureRow(
                                icon: KitIcons.camera,
                                title: 'Smart sorting',
                                detail: 'Included when it arrives',
                                tone: KitFeatureTone.lilac,
                                chipLabel: 'Coming soon',
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 20),
                              IntrinsicHeight(
                                child: Row(
                                  crossAxisAlignment:
                                      CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                  children: [
                                    for (final (i, product)
                                        in products.indexed) ...[
                                      if (i > 0) const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                      Expanded(
                                        child: KitPlanCard(
                                          product: 'Sample Plus',
                                          period:
                                              product.period ==
                                                  PlusPeriod.yearly
                                              ? 'Yearly'
                                              : 'Monthly',
                                          price: product.priceLabel,
                                          priceUnit:
                                              product.period ==
                                                  PlusPeriod.yearly
                                              ? ' /year'
                                              : ' /month',
                                          detail: plus?.period == product.period
                                              ? 'Renews ${AppCopy.shortDate(plus!.renewsAt)}'
                                              : product.breakdown,
                                          badge: plus == null
                                              ? product.badge
                                              : null,
                                          current:
                                              plus?.period == product.period,
                                          selected:
                                              plus == null &&
                                              state.selected == product.period,
                                          onTap: plus == null
                                              ? () =>
                                                    cubit.select(product.period)
                                              : null,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                              if (plus == null) ...[
                                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                                KitTrialTimeline(
                                  steps: [
                                    const KitTimelineStep(
                                      title: 'Today',
                                      detail: 'Full access, free',
                                    ),
                                    KitTimelineStep(
                                      title: AppCopy.shortDate(reminderDay),
                                      detail: 'We remind you',
                                    ),
                                    KitTimelineStep(
                                      title: AppCopy.shortDate(chargeDay),
                                      detail: '${selected.priceLabel} billed',
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ],
                              const SizedBox(height: 14),
                              KitButton(
                                label: plus == null
                                    ? 'Start ${AppConfig.trialDays}-day free trial'
                                    : 'Sample Plus is active',
                                done: plus != null,
                                loading:
                                    state.status == PaywallStatus.purchasing,
                                onPressed: plus != null || busy
                                    ? null
                                    : cubit.purchase,
                              ),
                              if (plus == null)
                                Padding(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                                    8,
                                    10,
                                    8,
                                    0,
                                  ),
                                  child: Text.rich(
                                    TextSpan(
                                      text:
                                          '${AppConfig.trialDays} days free, then ',
                                      children: [
                                        TextSpan(
                                          text:
                                              '${selected.priceLabel} per $per',
                                          style: TextStyle(
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                            color: c.ink,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                        TextSpan(
                                          text:
                                              ' starting ${AppCopy.shortDate(chargeDay)}. '
                                              'Renews every $per until you cancel.',
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                    style: KitType.captionLarge.copyWith(
                                      color: c.ink2,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 22),
                              KitLegalText(
                                heading: 'Subscription terms',
                                paragraphs: [
                                  _freeNote,
                                  _plansNote(products),
                                  if (ios) _appleTerms else _googleTerms,
                                ],
                              ),
                              KitLinkRow(
                                links: [
                                  KitLink(
                                    label: 'Terms of Use (EULA)',
                                    onTap: () =>
                                        scope.links.open(AppLinks.terms),
                                  ),
                                  KitLink(
                                    label: 'Privacy Policy',
                                    onTap: () =>
                                        scope.links.open(AppLinks.privacy),
                                  ),
                                  KitLink(
                                    label: 'Restore Purchases',
                                    onTap: cubit.restore,
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          if (!_atEnd)
                            Positioned(
                              left: 0,
                              right: 0,
                              bottom: 0,
                              height: 44,
                              child: IgnorePointer(
                                child: DecoratedBox(
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                                      begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                                      end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                                      colors: [c.fade, c.ground],
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

const String _freeNote =
    'Sample is free to use with up to ${AppConfig.freeItemLimit} items. '
    'Sample Plus is optional.';

String _plansNote(List<PlusProduct> products) =>
    'Sample Plus Yearly is ${products.first.priceLabel} per year. '
    'Sample Plus Monthly is ${products.last.priceLabel} per month. Each plan '
    'includes a ${AppConfig.trialDays}-day free trial, once per account. '
    "When the trial ends, the plan's price is charged unless you cancel "
    'before then.';

const String _appleTerms =
    'Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your '
    'purchase. With a free trial, the first payment is charged when the '
    "trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it's canceled "
    'at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is '
    'charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You '
    'can manage and cancel your subscription in your App Store account '
    'settings after purchase.';

const String _googleTerms =
    'Payment is charged to your Google Play account when you confirm your '
    'purchase. With a free trial, the first payment is charged when the '
    'trial ends unless you cancel before then. The subscription renews '
    'automatically at the end of each period until you cancel. You can '
    'manage and cancel it anytime in Play Store subscriptions (Play Store › '
    'Payments and subscriptions › Subscriptions), and you keep Plus until the '
    'end of the period you paid for.';
